_meta.title: Clash Front zone PentaPet population + rarity gate
_meta.author: Map-maker session, 2026-07-07 (owner-tuned)
_meta.purpose: Seed-pass input: which pet ELEMENTS populate each zone (wild + recruit pool) and the RARITY BAND allowed there. Companion to data/zone-registry.json (keyed by the same zoneId) and data/world-zone-detail.json.
_meta.progression: STARTING = the up-to-RARE surface everyone can reach: Tianxia (the great convergence hub, biggest land) + the three starter zones Arcadia/Porthaven/Mythoria. RARE-GATED = the Sky (HS) and Underworld (UW) tiers — you need rare-tier progression to enter; they hold the legendary/mythic pets. HS3 + UW3 (highest sky / deepest hell) reach MYTHIC. CGI/KOL prestige islands = legendary/mythic residents only.
_meta.gateMeaning: rarityMin..rarityMax = the inclusive rarity band a pet must fall in to spawn/recruit in the zone. So a 'rare..legendary' zone spawns NO common/uncommon; a 'common..rare' starter spawns no legendary/mythic. Common(31)/uncommon(81)/rare(80) live in the starting band (~192 pets, open to all); legendary(26) gated to HS/UW; mythic(10) only HS3/UW3/CGI/KOL.
